rounds.text: Classic Electrodes (India) Ltd trades at a highly attractive P/E ratio of 8.36x [E1], representing a stark discount to the broader sector benchmark P/E of 27.45x [E6]. This low valuation is coupled with robust fundamental performance, highlighted by a 5-year compounded sales growth of 22% [E14] and an impressive 5-year compounded profit growth of 59% [E17]. The business generates quality returns, maintaining a solid ROCE of 19.3% [E12] and an ROE of 18.1% [E13], supported by a 3-year median ROE of 26% [E21]. Furthermore, the company is conservatively financed with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.21x [E31], having successfully reduced its borrowings down to Rs 20 Cr in March 2026 from Rs 54 Cr a year prior [E32], while delivering strong operating cash flows of Rs 19 Cr [E28] that fully back reported profits with a cash conversion ratio of 1.46x [E27]. Conceded: [E47], [E48], [E49], which point to a zero dividend yield [E4], a slight reduction in promoter holdings [E34], and lengthened working capital days [E49].
